extracted.name: Soup maker vegetable soup
extracted.description: Whizz up this versatile vegetable soup in a soup maker using your favourite vegetables. Serve with a dollop of crème fraîche and some herbs
ingredient_lines: 200g vegetables such as onions, celery and carrots, chopped
crème fraîche and fresh herbs, to serve
instruction_lines: Put the vegetables, potatoes, and stock into a soup blender, and press the ‘smooth soup’ function. Make sure you don’t fill the soup maker above the max fill line.
Once the cycle is complete, season, and pour into bowls with a dollop of crème fraîche and some herbs.
